title: Inline edit: move the other grids (related lists, dashboard tables, record picker, authored object-grid, ObjectView's grid) to select-first and per-cell save, retiring the pending-changes bar and Save All
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ④ · Source: fleet · child of epic #35683 (list inline edit redo). Seat 1's premise note on #35827 (7039688829) names this "later card" as the one #35827 waits for. No card carried it, so #35827 was put back in the queue on a wrong prerequisite.

## What happens today
Under #35685's first slice, per-cell autosave switches on only where the select-first cell model does: the grids a `ListView` draws, the scope of the maintainer's record 7035276698 on #35683. Every other grid keeps the pending-changes bar and "Save All":
- related lists
- dashboard tables
- the record picker
- authored `object-grid` nodes
- `ObjectView`'s own grid

So the same table behaves two ways depending on where it is drawn, and `ObjectGrid` keeps wiring `defaultBatchSave` (`onBatchSave`, `data-table.tsx:3275`) for them.

## Done when
- Each grid above uses the select-first cell model and saves each cell on its own, the same way as the list (#35683's design).
- The pending-changes bar and "Save All" no longer appear in those grids.
- Then #35827 retires the `onBatchSave` slot.
- Pins: one related list and one dashboard table, where an edited cell saves on its own and no "Save All" is drawn, each with an ablation.
- Read first:
  - Which of these grids actually offer inline edit today?
  - Does a related list inside a parent form that is saved together (#35590's group-placed children) need to keep a batch save? If so, this needs a ruling before build.

reach: every non-list grid that offers inline edit; read from code (seat 1, #35685).
Business reason: the same table saves differently depending on where it is drawn.
Reader: domain:ui (ui/packages/plugin-grid, components data-table).
Dedupe: `"Save All" related list per-cell`, `select-first related lists inline edit` → only #35827 and #35683.
Grade: p2 (epic child).
